insight: Founded in 2020 by the team behind personality-marketing tool Sorter; raised $13.2M led by Norwest.
name: Lavender
tagline: Real-time AI email coach that scores and improves sales emails as you write.
description: Lavender is an email intelligence tool that grades sales emails in real time and suggests edits to lift reply rates, drawing on analysis of billions of emails. It runs as a browser extension alongside your inbox and adds Ora, an AI agent that drafts cold emails modeled on top-performing patterns.
edge: Real-time inbox coaching scoring drafts against billions of emails — improves your writing, not just generates copy.
pros: Coaches your writing, not just drafts
